source_extraction_notes: Sourced from .claude/skills/brand-design-systems/aesthetics/editorial.md. The editorial aesthetic ships dark-on-light primary tokens (#111111 on #FFFFFF) with no warm tone. The editorial-kinetic-type skill enforces a fixed warm-paper baseline (cream/clay/ink) for the serif format identity, and that baseline is the canonical visual rendering of the editorial aesthetic in this pipeline. The mapping below preserves the editorial register (high-contrast serif on a paper canvas) while honoring the renderer constraints (offline fonts only: Bitstream Charter, DejaVu Serif, Georgia, DejaVu Sans).

fonts.registry_note: The brand-video font registry described in the orchestrator (Inter, IBMPlexSerif, EBGaramond, etc.) cannot be loaded by the editorial-kinetic-type renderer, which requires offline-rendering with sandbox-resident fonts. Mapping to the closest available family: Bitstream Charter stands in for IBM Plex Serif as the editorial display face, DejaVu Sans stands in for Inter for eyebrow/italic copy.

typography.case: mixed (eyebrows render uppercase per scene 2 contract; headlines mixed-case)

motion.rationale: editorial aesthetic uses fade transitions; the editorial-kinetic-type skill ships 0.4s ease-out fade-in and 0.27s ease-out fade-out plus a single 0.55s scale-in on scene 5 primary

accent_on_canvas.threshold_skill_default: n/a (validator skips contrast check when theme is the named default)
accent_on_canvas.explanation: The editorial-kinetic-type default theme ships clay (#CC785C) against cream (#F0EEE6), which falls below the orchestrator's 3.5:1 accent-on-canvas threshold. The skill spec uses accent on a single emphasis phrase per scene at very large display sizes, so the practical readability bar is met. Falling back to the orchestrator's #FFFFFF canvas would not improve this ratio (CC785C on #FFFFFF measures ~3.0:1) and would break the editorial warm-paper identity. Keeping the cream canvas and the clay accent as the editorial visual signature.

fallback_notes: Accent contrast of CC785C on F0EEE6 (~2.6:1) is below the orchestrator's 3.5:1 token contract. Documented as an intentional editorial deviation rather than a swap, because falling back to #FFFFFF canvas would still fail the contract and would also break the format's editorial paper identity.

Font registry from the orchestrator's brand-video skill is not loadable by the editorial-kinetic-type renderer; fell back to sandbox-resident families (Bitstream Charter / DejaVu Serif / DejaVu Sans).
